purpose: Release regression evaluation set for the GBSS AI & Service Intelligence workflow.

full_release_required_for: prompt version 或模型快照变更
AI Status has no pending state

cases.name: Event intelligence golden evaluation
pass_criteria: All metrics meet evals/v3_1_event_cases.json thresholds.
No API or external network call is made.
No case produces an automatic final P0.

cases.name: DingTalk event schema contract validation
pass_criteria: The seven existing DingTalk business-sheet contracts and required lineage fields remain defined.
No database migration, second local business database, sheet write, field write or Config write occurs.

cases.name: Adapter, LLM budget and circuit-breaker tests
pass_criteria: All adapters are testable without network.
Budget and open-circuit paths skip before the provider call.
Failures retain audit metadata.

cases.name: DingTalk transient timeout recovery
pass_criteria: A transient operator remote-timeout response is retried.
A resolved operator ID is reused within the process.
A transient table transport error is retried with bounded backoff.
Permanent validation and authentication errors are not swallowed.

cases.name: DingTalk paid API no-change efficiency
pass_criteria: Created News rows are combined with the initial snapshot using the DingTalk-returned record IDs, and an ID-count mismatch fails closed.
An Event upsert with zero rows returns before any list_records call.
A configured Audit Trail sheet appends without list-sheets or get-all-fields schema discovery.
The optimization never caches or changes human News.Status and does not relax audit recovery.

cases.name: Unit test regression suite
prd_capabilities: AI Status has no pending state
pass_criteria: Command exits 0.
No existing test is skipped because of the new feature.
Any changed behavior has an explicit updated assertion.
Per-group candidate caps retain previous-calendar-day results before same-day, older, or missing-date results while preserving cross-group round-robin coverage.
Official HTML adapters rank recent dated article links ahead of navigation, locale, CSS, generic call-to-action anchors and pinned older articles before applying the result limit.
Critical-scan candidates are rechecked after article extraction and missing-date or out-of-window rows cannot be written or alerted as fresh critical events.
HTTP 200 webhook responses with a non-zero DingTalk errcode are treated as failed deliveries and retain the returned error for audit.
Immigration or H-1B uses of the word visa do not match the Visa payment-network entity, while official-domain and payment-context uses still do.
AI Status is separate from effective Status; only high-confidence, traceable previous-day recommendations may auto-accept at 11:50 and no AI path can assign final P0.
Human decisions take precedence and matched/overridden outcomes are retained as versioned feedback without online self-modifying rules.
Every News row receives one of 已采纳, 已拒绝 or 已重复 in AI Status; AI Status never remains 待处理, while human Status may remain pending; later runs are fingerprint-incremental and never use legacy 建议 labels.
The 09:00 review reminder fails closed when any eligible previous-day row has no valid AI Status.
Previously separate Event Cases that now cluster together retain one stable Event ID; superseded rows are archived with a merge target and cannot re-enter any management output.

cases.name: Daily health check dry run
pass_criteria: Command exits 0 when at least one provider is available and News table is reachable.
Output includes provider details.
Output includes News table record count.
Dry run does not send DingTalk alert when healthy.

cases.name: Legacy single-item daily publisher remains disabled
cases.command: Inspect settings.schedule.daily_publish.enabled and installed launchd plists.
pass_criteria: settings.schedule.daily_publish.enabled is false.
No daily_publish launchd plist is installed.

cases.name: Daily Report accepted-News Event dry run
pass_criteria: Every selected Event is backed by at least one News=已采纳 row.
Selected Events have neither Daily Report Sent At nor the transition Weekly Headlines Sent At marker.
Rendered content includes Event, Source URL, Publish Date, Evidence and Claim lineage.
A multilingual pipe-delimited title prefers a substantial readable Latin translation instead of an unreadable non-Latin prefix or publisher suffix.
When any source was accepted by AI_Deadline or AI_Deadline_Recovery, the footer discloses deadline fallback and does not claim universal manual verification.
Dry run sends no group message and writes no delivery marker.

cases.name: Daily KPI observation snapshot dry run
pass_criteria: Output includes the v3.1 KPI observation status when Event Intelligence is enabled.
RunLog metadata contains the complete KPI snapshot.
Audit Trail receives HEALTH.v3_1_kpi with mode=dry-run.
Pre-observation critical backfills remain visible but are excluded from the production SLA denominator.
The previous-day review batch exposes completed, pending, AI-aligned and overridden counts plus an estimated review workload.
High-relevance signal throughput excludes News linked only to archived or rejected Events and reports the excluded count separately.
Estimated review minutes remain marked requires_manual_sample and cannot by themselves satisfy the ten-minute outcome.
A bounded manual timing command can record actual date, minutes and reviewed count in RunLog and Audit Trail without adding a business table.

cases.name: Manual ChatGPT Deep Research handoff dry run
pass_criteria: The handoff presents three to four distinct research directions grounded in accepted Event inputs.
The output contains a paste-ready ChatGPT Deep Research prompt with sources, counter-evidence and GBSS mapping requirements.
No OpenAI API call, cost reservation or report write occurs in dry-run.

cases.name: Weekly final dry run
pass_criteria: A valid Research Queue.Research Document URL renders one DingTalk report link plus deduplicated Event/news titles, source links and Publish Dates.
A DingTalk link-cell object is normalized to its HTTP(S) link; if exact period labels differ, only a manual plan requested within the preceding three days may be reused.
A concise English no-access hint with the DingTalk join-group link appears immediately below the report link and before Weekly Key Events & News.
The message contains no internal Event/Evidence/Claim IDs and no image One Pager is generated or uploaded.
A missing or invalid report URL is reported as blocked; live mode writes no Weekly Intelligence Sent At.
Dry run sends no group message and writes no delivery marker.

cases.name: Weekly research preparation and evidence-gated rendering
pass_criteria: Research Queue, Evidence Bank and Claim Ledger are available and linked by Research ID.
Candidate evidence is marked Pending, not treated as verified evidence.
When the quality gate is incomplete, the rendered brief is labelled Signal Brief and includes the gate blockers.
No synthetic P0 priority or Deep Research conclusion is created from unreviewed evidence.
Audit Trail records research preparation and draft rendering with the same weekly run lineage.

cases.name: Provider fallback and ingest continuity
cases.command: Use settings UI or temporary settings to make primary provider unavailable while fallback_provider points to a known file-backed provider, then run python scripts/daily_fetch.py.
pass_criteria: daily_fetch does not stop at primary provider failure when fallback works.
Run log records used_provider as fallback provider.
Pipeline steps include provider check, News write, title refresh, publish date backfill, semantic dedupe.
DingTalk notification reports the degraded but completed run.

cases.name: News canonical sheet and field integrity
cases.command: Inspect settings and one list_records call for DingTalk AI Table News.
pass_criteria: Active sheet is News / oMbefcK unless intentionally overridden with documented reason.

Required fields exist: No, Section, Title, Label, Source URL, Source, Publish Date, Review Status, Search Provider, Search Query, Search Batch, Discovery Type, First Seen At, Duplicate Of, Rejection Reason.
New records default to 待处理.
Duplicate records can point to Duplicate Of.

cases.name: Weekly final live publish writeback
cases.command: Run weekly_publish without --dry-run only in the intended release window or a controlled test webhook/table.
pass_criteria: Insights has a Final report row with source Event/News lineage.
Research Document URL is present and organization-readable after the reader joins the authorized DingTalk group.
The configured group receives the research document link plus deduplicated Event/news titles, source URLs and Publish Dates; no image One Pager or QR delivery is created.
A missing, stale or invalid research link fails closed and Insights/Audit retain the failed delivery evidence.
DingTalk status is sent.
Source Event/News records receive Weekly Intelligence Sent At only after successful notification.
cases.notes: Updated for REQ-114..REQ-117: v3.1 replaced image/QR One Pager delivery with a manual DingTalk research-document link plus Event/news digest.

cases.name: Config and launchd schedule persistence
cases.command: Run config sync/apply flow, reinstall launchd from settings UI or scheduler command, then inspect installed plist and launchctl state.
pass_criteria: Config sheet contains daily headline and weekly insight schedule keys.
Editable schedule changes are reflected in local settings.
launchd plist uses the persisted settings.
launchctl reports the expected installed jobs.

cases.name: Audit Trail sheet and core workflow lineage
cases.command: Run .venv/bin/python scripts/ensure_audit_trail.py, then run a controlled dry-run of daily_health_check, daily_publish, weekly_draft or weekly_publish and inspect Audit Trail.
pass_criteria: Audit Trail is a separate sheet and its id is persisted in settings/Config.
The sheet has Run ID, Stage Code, Status, Input Summary, Output Summary, Source Record IDs, Report ID, Artifact URL, Error and Metadata JSON fields.
The controlled workflow creates a start, at least one material stage and a completion event with the same Run ID.
A workflow failure creates a failed completion event without preventing local RunLog capture.

cases.name: Research evidence and claim lineage
cases.command: Run python scripts/prepare_weekly_research.py --recent-count 5 and inspect the linked Research Queue, Evidence Bank, Claim Ledger and Audit Trail rows.
pass_criteria: Each evidence row links to Research ID and, where available, the original News record ID and source URL.
Evidence source tier and reviewer status are retained as separate fields.
Claim Ledger stores claim type, evidence IDs, boundary/counter-evidence, confidence and reviewer status.
The research quality gate is reproducible from the retained fields and is recorded in Audit Trail metadata.

cases.name: Human feedback learning remains bounded and auditable
pass_criteria: Only segments with at least five human decisions and 80% agreement affect a recommendation.
Explicit duplicates and missing URL or Publish Date always retain their hard-gate decision.
Every override receives a normalized reason and readable explanation.
The daily review card reports agreement and top override directions without a second notification.
No paid model call or opaque online model update is used.

cases.name: Unchanged AI recommendation can enter deadline fallback
pass_criteria: A fingerprint-current AI accepted row can receive the deadline Status patch without KeyError.
Human decisions still take precedence.
Live RunLog starts before DingTalk News/Event reads and planning.
Any read or planning failure is finalized as failed and written to Audit.
Daily Report deadline guard reuses the same eligibility rules and is idempotent after a successful 11:50 run.
Missed deadlines recover at most five newest rows from the preceding seven days and never recover archived, merged, rejected, low-confidence or human-terminal records.
The 12:00 report guard can recover a missed previous-day deadline but never consumes a second overdue-recovery batch.
After News acceptance, the deadline or report guard synchronizes linked active Events to accepted without reopening terminal Events.

cases.name: Daily Report sends an explicit empty-day heartbeat
pass_criteria: Zero selected items renders a concise no-new-accepted-events message.
The message cannot be confused with a failed task.
No internal lineage IDs or reviewer mention are shown.
No sent markers are written for an empty report.

cases.name: Event status converges to linked human News decisions
pass_criteria: Any accepted linked News keeps the Event accepted.
All terminal duplicate News archives the Event while News retains duplicate lineage.
A terminal set containing a human rejection marks the Event rejected.
Pending News prevents terminal closure.
Merged archived Events are never reopened.

cases.name: Obsolete Event Entity relations are auditable but inactive
pass_criteria: Current expected Event Entity relations remain active.
An obsolete relation on the same active Event becomes superseded with zero confidence.
Relations for unrelated or archived Event IDs are unchanged.
No historical relation row is deleted.

cases.name: Expired AI-rejected General Events leave the active review backlog
pass_criteria: Only General or Market Context Events whose review day passed are eligible.
Every linked News must remain human-pending and have AI Status rejected.
Strategic, P0 Candidate, specifically typed, accepted or current-review Events remain active.
News Status is not changed by Event archival.
Later human acceptance can reopen the Event through normal eventization.

cases.name: DingTalk notification routing and mention check
cases.command: Send controlled daily and weekly notifications to configured test or production groups.
pass_criteria: Daily/reminder messages go to daily/review group.
Weekly draft/final messages go to weekly/publish group.
Configured atMobiles/atUserIds produce real DingTalk mentions, not text-only @.
Review reminders include News approval view link.

cases.name: GBSS report content quality review
cases.command: Review the weekly draft/final content and one-page brief generated from at least 5 accepted records.
pass_criteria: Report is clearly for GBSS management, not generic AI news.
Executive Summary states what changed and why it matters.
Priority News Cards include source/domain links.
GBSS Impact Analysis maps to business support, organization transformation, OPC, internal efficiency, contact center insight, governance or vendor strategy.
Actions are specific enough to drive research, PoC, benchmark, risk watch or process improvement.
One-page brief is readable in DingTalk on desktop and mobile.

cases.name: Audit Trail readability and report lineage review
cases.command: Open Audit Trail in DingTalk AI Table after one controlled daily publish and one weekly draft/final run.
pass_criteria: An operator can filter a complete workflow by Run ID and read stages in execution order.
Weekly events expose source record IDs, report ID, document/image artifact links and delivery outcome.
Failed or skipped stages are distinguishable from success and include a useful error or output summary.
Audit records are separate from News and Insights and are append-only in normal operation.

cases.name: Deep Research evidence and CEO-readiness review
cases.command: Review one completed research topic, its source pack, DingTalk research document and link-plus-news preview before a management send.
pass_criteria: Every material fact or number can be traced to one or more Evidence Bank IDs.
Inferences state their assumptions, scope or counter-evidence and are not presented as facts.
The report uses Deep Research only after the quality gate passes; otherwise it visibly remains Signal Brief.
The Deep Dive answers a decision-relevant question with GBSS-specific mechanism, risk and tradeoff rather than a news summary.
The DingTalk research link opens for authorized group members; the adjacent English access hint routes unauthorized readers to the join-group link before the Event/news digest.
cases.notes: Removed obsolete image and QR assertions because REQ-117 disables image One Pager delivery; access is now validated through the report link and join-group hint.

cases.name: PRD and evaluation set consistency
cases.command: Read docs/prd_v3_1_event_intelligence.md, docs/v3_1_event_intelligence_spec.md, evals/release_evaluation_set.md and evals/release_evaluation_set.json before release.
pass_criteria: New feature maps to at least one PRD capability or the PRD is updated.
Evaluation set has at least one case covering the feature's release risk.
The acceptance checklist table is generated from JSON and its case IDs and types exactly match the JSON case list.
Known skipped cases are documented with reason and owner.
